summary: Capcom's gothic 2D fighting series; use Capcom Fighting Collection on PC for the arcade games' modern fidelity/features, and preserve Darkstalkers Chronicle separately for its all-style remix structure.

entries.title: Darkstalkers: The Night Warriors

emulation.notes: Use PC collection first; emulate older releases only for comparison.

primary.why: The 2022 collection includes the original arcade game with modern display options, online play, training/spectator features, save states, museum material, and the highest official PC fidelity ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version of Capcom Fighting Collection; use PlayStation/PS2 or original arcade hardware only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Collection route is an arcade re-release with modern options, not a remake; PlayStation-era home ports remain historical variants.

entries.title: Night Warriors: Darkstalkers' Revenge

emulation.notes: Use PC collection first; Saturn/arcade emulation is for comparison.

primary.why: The 2022 PC collection includes the arcade game with rollback online play, training/spectator features, save states, museum content, and the highest official modern fidelity ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version of Capcom Fighting Collection; use Darkstalkers Resurrection only if you specifically want its 2013 presentation layer.

entries.remaster_caveats: Darkstalkers Resurrection remains a notable prior release, but the 2022 collection covers the full arcade subseries.

entries.title: Vampire Savior: The Lord of Vampire
entries.definitive_edition: Capcom Fighting Collection for arcade fidelity, plus PlayStation Darkstalkers 3 for home roster content

emulation.emulator: None for PC; DuckStation/Saturn emulator fallback
emulation.notes: Use the PC collection for main play and a PlayStation emulator only for the combined roster variant.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC collection plus high-resolution PS1 emulation for secondary content

primary.why: The 2022 PC collection gives the arcade game the best official modern route with online play, training/spectator features, save states, and museum extras; the home ports' combined-roster material is tracked as secondary content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version of Capcom Fighting Collection for the arcade game, then sample the PlayStation Darkstalkers 3 home version if you want the combined home-port roster.

secondary.exclusive_content: Darkstalkers 3 home version combines characters from Vampire Savior, Vampire Savior 2, and Vampire Hunter 2.
secondary.what_to_play: Play or sample the PlayStation Darkstalkers 3 version for the merged all-character roster.
secondary.why: The PC collection is the fidelity route, but the PlayStation home version has sourced combined-roster content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate the arcade Vampire Savior route with the PlayStation Darkstalkers 3 home remix; they preserve different content priorities.

entries.title: Vampire Hunter 2: Darkstalkers' Revenge

primary.why: This Japan-only arcade revision was first released internationally in Capcom Fighting Collection, and the PC version has the highest official fidelity ceiling plus modern online/training features.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version of Capcom Fighting Collection; use the PS2 Japan collection only for archival comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Collection route is an arcade re-release with modern features, not a remake.

entries.title: Vampire Savior 2: The Lord of Vampire

primary.why: This Japan-only arcade revision was first released internationally in Capcom Fighting Collection; PC gives it the highest official fidelity ceiling and modern online/training features.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version of Capcom Fighting Collection; use the PS2 Japan collection only for archival comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Collection route is an arcade re-release with modern features, not a remake.

entries.title: Darkstalkers Chronicle: The Chaos Tower

emulation.notes: Upscale the PSP version for the cleanest modern archival route.

primary.why: The PSP version is the international release of the Dreamcast Vampire Chronicle remix, combining all characters, endings, moves, selectable play styles from all five arcade games, soundtrack selection, and PSP-specific release availability.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP version on original hardware or PPSSPP with upscaling; use the Dreamcast version only for the Japan-only Matching Service original.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a remix/compilation-style entry, not a separate story sequel.
